#183498 TC1 (Shipment Value read-only) was a false fail: SuiteCRM served stale cached templates. After a deploy run Admin > Repair > Quick Repair and Rebuild, then hard-reload (Ctrl+Shift+R) the EditView; clearing browser cache or cookies does not help. Never click Execute on SQL the repair proposes without approval.

TC1 on #183498: expected Shipment Value and Shipment Value USD fields in the Shipment Protection panel are not editable (read-only/grey); actual Both Shipment Value and Shipment Value USD fields are editable; the agent successfully typed '2000' into the Shipment Value field and '5000' into the Shipment Value USD field, and the page captures show the fields as [active].

CRM admin settings saveRewardsPanel, saveShipmentProtection, saveExpressCategoryWeightDefaults, saveExpressPricingSettings must be opened from Administration (action=index); direct URLs give an XSRF error.

CRM modules: Shipping Only AOS_Invoices, Buy & Ship incl. BX AOS_Quotes, Payments sav_payments, Clients Contacts, Rewards Redeemed sav_rewards_redeemed, Loyalty Rewards sav_rewards. The CRM record id equals the id in portal invoice/edit URLs.
Portal account pages: /rewards, /profile, /change-password, /warehouse-addresses, /delivery-addresses.
Portal Savo Express /savo-express, cart /savo-express/cart; Express orders appear in the Buy & Ship list as BX numbers. Orders have no detail page; editedOrder expands the card in the list.

Portal Buy & Ship: list /buy-and-ship, create /buy-and-ship/create, open order /buy-and-ship?editedOrder=<B-number>, edit /buy-and-ship/edit/<record id>?orderNumber=<B-number>, invoice/payment /buy-and-ship/invoice/<record id>.
Portal Shipping Only: list /shipping-only, create /shipping-only/create, open order /shipping-only?editedOrder=<A-number>, invoice/payment /shipping-only/invoice/<crm record id>.
All Redmine posts go through Hammad Iqbal's account, never Sidney's.
A Savo Express order is created only after payment; other order types still get an order ID up front.
Adding to the cart opens an 'Added to cart' prompt with Checkout and Continue shopping.
Intercom on the portal stays as it is; do not flag it or suggest changing it.
Savo Express prices show as they are, with no 'est.' or 'estimated' label (#182698 won't do); do not flag it.
Classic Buy & Ship is paid by bank transfer; Stripe card tests for non-Express orders pay an existing unpaid Shipping Only order with the 4242 test card. Do not create new orders for this.
Shipping Only is its own portal module with its own menu, separate from Buy & Ship.
